title: Venezuelan Orange Skewers
description: A citrusy and light Venezuelan dish featuring caramel sauce and flambe, perfect for a diabetic-friendly dessert option
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat
In a small saucepan, combine brown sugar, water, and butter, and cook over medium heat, stirring until sugar dissolves
Bring the sugar mixture to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes
Add cinnamon to the sugar mixture and stir to combine
Brush the skewers with the sugar mixture
Grill the skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until caramelized
If using rum, flambe the skewers by pouring rum over them and igniting with a match
Serve the skewers warm, garnished with additional cinnamon if desired
